# guide blob

- **CURIE:** [`gmeow:guideBlob`](gmeow-guideBlob.md)
- **IRI:** <https://blackcatinformatics.ca/gmeow/guideBlob>
- **Category:** property
- **Defined by:** [`gmeow:slices/kernel`](../../slices/kernel.md)

Links a slice to the content-addressed digest of its Tier-2 narrative guide as embedded in a GTS package: the guide rides the same file as the ontology, sub-profiled per slice, and a consumer resolves guide ↔ slice from the graph itself. The value is the blob digest string; the docs-in-sync invariant (every guide anchor resolves to a live term) is enforced by the package build, so the linkage is trustworthy from the hash chain alone ([Principle 7](https://github.com/Blackcat-Informatics/gmeow-ontology/blob/main/CONSTITUTION.md#principle-7)).

## Structure

**Property shape:** annotation property

## Practical Pattern

Use [`gmeow:guideBlob`](gmeow-guideBlob.md) when the definition matches the source fact. Prefer a narrower GMEOW term when one exists, and keep projection concerns in the mapping layer.
